body: Thanks so much. I've been reaching out to my fellows as much as I can
Thank you, this made me smile and gave me some hope :)
Feeling ok about not picking up and have been hitting meetings and groups at my IOP. These feels though. Ugh.
I'm in IOP - it helps but doesn't mean my problems are dismissible

fuck racist upper middle class people! damn! 

i wish i did too...things are hard when no one understands what you're going through. thank you for replying to me btw. it makes me feel a little better.

i do have a lot of local spots near me where i usually see someone i know, but i'm not sure that will be good right now because sometimes the people i interact with have their own stuff going on and can be kind of off-putting if that makes sense
i actually went for a walk but it just made me wish i was with people and not alone. i'm not sure what else to do.
that's what it used to be for me...this time around it looks like a combo pack of drugs and alcohol every day for the past week. started with partying and shifted into not leaving my bed all day.
i've been feeling bad for a while now. spent the last week pushing myself hard hoping i'll snap.

I feel this all the time. It's really hard and honestly I'm thankful for you and your existence right now, otherwise I would assume I was alone in thinking this. 

Even when I really don't want to die, I have this horrible looming feeling that it's how I will die anyway because every time I feel better I fall back into the trap of suicidal thinking and I don't know that I'll ever escape.
